climate: A dry climate, with little rain while the vines grow. Water is scarce and the dry air keeps disease down.

blurb.text: A South Australian zone with Riverland inside it and about 55,000 acres of vines, covering a large area. South Australia as a whole makes more than half of all Australian wine.
